# Minimal SCORM 1.2 Test Course — Course Summary

## Chapter 1: Introduction

This lesson introduces SCORM 1.2, explaining it as a set of technical standards for eLearning software that enables communication between online learning content and learning management systems. It outlines key components such as the imsmanifest.xml file, which defines course structure, SCOs (Shareable Content Objects) as individual learning units, and the LMS that hosts SCORM courses. The learning objectives include understanding the SCORM 1.2 package structure, verifying imsmanifest.xml parsing, and confirming HTML content extraction. The content provides foundational knowledge necessary for working with SCORM packages and their components. It also clarifies the purpose of the test package in validating scraping services for SCORM courses.

# Chapter 1: Introduction


---

Chapter 1: Introduction to SCORM

This is a minimal SCORM 1.2 test package created for the SCORM Scraper QA suite.

Learning Objectives
Understand SCORM 1.2 package structure
Verify imsmanifest.xml parsing
Confirm HTML content extraction
What is SCORM?

SCORM (Sharable Content Object Reference Model) is a set of technical standards for eLearning software products. It defines how online learning content and learning management systems communicate with each other.

Key Components
imsmanifest.xml — the course structure definition
SCO (Shareable Content Object) — individual learning units
LMS — Learning Management System that hosts SCORM courses
Summary: This package validates that the scraping service correctly identifies and extracts a single-SCO SCORM 1.2 course.
